subject.title: [Feature]:Support per-agent command lanes for multi-agent deployments

question: What public scheduler and config contract should OpenClaw use for foreground per-agent command lane isolation on shared gateways?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix would add durable public config and scheduler semantics for lane ownership, aggregate caps, and request trust boundaries.

options.title: Trusted Per-Agent Lanes
options.body: Add validated agent/default lane config for foreground runs while retaining per-session serialization and a process-wide safety cap.

options.title: Unified Scheduler Design First
options.body: Defer this issue until foreground, subagent, hook, browser, and channel-specific lanes share one coordinated scheduler contract.

options.title: Document Process Isolation
options.body: Keep the shared main lane as the product contract and document separate gateway processes as the supported isolation boundary.

recommendation.title: Trusted Per-Agent Lanes
recommendation.body: Add validated agent/default lane config for foreground runs while retaining per-session serialization and a process-wide safety cap.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits show the strongest ownership signal across gateway lane setup and embedded agent runtime lane behavior.
